name: Constructor University
summary: Private English-taught university in Bremen, formerly Jacobs University, with an international student body living on one residential campus.

ib.text: Holistic review of grades, a motivation essay and a CV. If your IB does not give direct entry to a German university, admission can be conditional on SAT/ACT. IB English A at 6 or 7 proves your English.

dates.label: Rolling admissions close (visa and no-visa applicants)

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer science taught fully online, mostly through recorded lectures with live tutorials: programming, algorithms, databases, AI and software engineering, plus a compulsory summer internship between years two and three.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: Taught entirely online, from home; Computer Science is on campus, with its own Cybersecurity specialisation.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: A new degree from 2027 (accreditation expected in spring 2027): a strong maths and computer science base first, then machine learning and AI methods, with a compulsory internship and a study-abroad window in semester 5.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Biochemistry and Cell Biology
programmes.about: Life at the level of molecules and cells, with lab courses every year from chromatography to genetic engineering, a two-month summer internship and specialisations such as biomedicine.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Chemistry and Biotechnology
programmes.about: Inorganic, organic and physical chemistry combined with industrial biotechnology and bioprocess engineering, with labs, a summer internship and specialisations such as organometallic chemistry.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Computer and Information Technology
programmes.about: New from 2027 (accreditation expected in spring 2027): building, integrating and running secure, dependable computing and communication systems, with an internship, a study-abroad window and an optional business or engineering minor.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Classic computer science: C/C++ programming, algorithms and maths first, then databases, operating systems and software engineering, with a summer internship and specialisations including cybersecurity.
programmes.ib: Includes a Cybersecurity specialization with its own page: apply to Computer Science and choose it.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Earth Sciences and Sustainable Management of Environmental Resources
programmes.about: Processes at the Earth's surface and how natural resources are managed, mixing geoscience and geochemistry with economics, advanced field labs and a two-month internship.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Electrical and Computer Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical engineering centred on communications, signal processing and embedded systems, from circuits and physics labs to wireless and RF design, with a two-month internship or a start-up option.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Global Economics and Management
programmes.about: Economics and management for a globalised world: public policy, environmental and international economics alongside marketing, with a two-month internship, an optional semester abroad and specialisations such as econometrics.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.about: Industrial engineering joined with management: logistics, production planning, operations research, lean methods and AI for industry, with a four-month internship in semester 5.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Integrated Social and Cognitive Psychology
programmes.about: Psychology joining its social and cognitive sides, from memory and learning to neurobiology and culture, with statistics and research methods throughout, a summer internship and options such as social neuroscience.
programmes.ib: Does not prepare you for psychotherapist licensure in Germany; Constructor says it qualifies for many psychology master's programmes in the US, the UK and elsewhere.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.about: International business: finance, accounting and economics first, then marketing, investments, strategy and entrepreneurship, with a two-month internship, an optional semester abroad and specialisations such as lean management.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: International Relations: Politics and History
programmes.about: International relations taught with modern history: IR theory, political economy and the history of globalisation, then specialisations such as international law or China, with a summer internship.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Management, Decisions and Data Analytics
programmes.about: Business management combined with the psychology of decision-making and hands-on data analytics (machine learning, statistics in R, visualisation), with a two-month internship and specialisations such as financial data analytics.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Mathematics, Modeling and Data Analytics
programmes.about: Pure mathematics (analysis, algebra, number theory) paired with modelling real-world problems and data-driven methods in Python, with a summer internship and specialisations from financial maths to topology.
programmes.ib: A Sparkasse scholarship of up to €4,800 a year goes to selected maths applicants; it closed well before admissions last year, so apply early.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology
programmes.about: How drugs act on the body, from molecules to physiology: organic, medicinal and pharmaceutical chemistry with chemical biology and lab work, a two-month internship and specialisations such as antibiotic discovery.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Physics and Data Science
programmes.about: A full physics degree, from mechanics and electrodynamics to quantum and statistical physics, taught with Python programming, modelling and data science, advanced labs and a summer internship.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Robotics and Intelligent Systems
programmes.about: Engineering autonomous machines: maths, physics, C/C++ and electronics first, then robotics, AI, machine learning and control, with a summer internship and specialisations such as marine robotics.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

programmes.name: Software, Data and Technology
programmes.about: An advanced computing degree for students who already program well: software development, data analysis and machine learning (including Kotlin), run with the JetBrains Foundation, and an extended thesis project.
programmes.ib: For students with prior programming experience, such as olympiads or contests; the JetBrains Foundation offers full scholarships to top students.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of your grades, motivation essay, CV and any references; no NC, test or interview. Decision in 2–4 weeks; places are not published.

notes: Decisions come 2 to 4 weeks after you apply, and every applicant is considered for a grade-based scholarship of up to €10,000 with no separate form.
If your diploma does not give direct entry to a German university, you may be admitted on condition that you sit the SAT or ACT.
Tuition is €11,925 a semester in 2027/28, plus up to €350 in fees and a one-time €640 enrolment fee for EU students; part can be deferred until you work.
